name: AcousticPro ANC Wireless Headphones with 40H Playtime
description: Engineered for audiophiles and remote workers alike. The AcousticPro features hybrid Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) with 3 custom modes, custom-tuned 40mm titanium diaphragm drivers, and plush memory foam protein leather ear cushions. Enjoy crystal-clear calling with dual AI beamforming microphones and low latency gaming mode.
shortDescription: Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation with dual AI mics, 40-hour battery, and fast USB-C charge.
features: Industry-leading Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation up to 38dB
Multi-point Bluetooth 5.3 pairs simultaneously to phone and laptop

name: AeroSync Ultrawatch 2 AMOLED 1.96" Display with Bluetooth Calling
description: Transform your daily productivity and fitness tracking with the AeroSync Ultrawatch 2. Showcasing an ultra-bright 1.96" Super AMOLED display with 1000 nits peak brightness, aerospace-grade titanium alloy bezel, built-in dual-satellite GPS, and continuous heart rate, SpO2, and sleep tracking.
shortDescription: 1.96" Super AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, SpO2 & ECG sensor, 7-day battery life.
features: Crystal-clear Bluetooth calling with noise-canceling mic
Always-On AMOLED display with 150+ customizable watch faces

name: LuminaSmart RGB Ambient Desk & Floor Lamp with Alexa/Google Sync
description: Elevate your interior lighting with 16 million colors and tunable warm-to-cool white balance. Designed in a minimalist Nordic cylindrical silhouette with matte aluminum body.
shortDescription: 16 Million RGB colors, voice control with Alexa/Google, music sync mode.

name: Artisan Crafted Full-Grain Italian Leather Weekender Duffel Bag
description: Handmade by master artisans using vegetable-tanned full-grain top leather that develops a gorgeous, rich patina over time.
shortDescription: Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, waterproof shoe pocket, brass hardware.

name: BrewMaster Precision Italian Espresso Machine with Milk Steamer
description: Bring the cafe experience to your countertop. The BrewMaster delivers professional 20-bar Italian ULKA pump pressure and thermoblock heating.
shortDescription: 20-bar Italian pump pressure, rapid thermoblock heater, stainless steam wand.

name: StairMaster 8Gx Commercial Revolving Stair Climber Stepmill
description: The pinnacle of commercial fitness equipment. The StairMaster 8Gx Commercial Revolving Stair Climber delivers superior lower body conditioning and high-intensity cardio training. Features a heavy-duty steel frame, smooth revolving stairs with non-slip tread, an intuitive 15.6-inch HD touchscreen console with virtual trails and workout metrics.
shortDescription: Commercial revolving stair climber with 15.6" HD touchscreen console & multi-grip ergonomic handles.
features: Commercial grade revolving stair climber engineered for elite cardio
15.6" HD touchscreen console with interactive workout programs
Complimentary white-glove doorstep delivery and technician assembly

name: Horizon Fitness 7.0AT Studio Smart Motorized Treadmill
description: Engineered for high-intensity studio workouts and endurance runners. The Horizon Fitness 7.0AT Treadmill features a powerful 3.0 CHP rapid-sync motor, 3-zone Variable Response Cushioning deck to protect joints, and QuickDial wheel controls for effortless speed and incline adjustments.
shortDescription: 3.0 CHP motor, Variable Response 3-zone cushioning, QuickDial controls & hydraulic folding.
features: QuickDial controls allow rapid changes to speed and incline
FeatherLight hydraulic folding frame for compact storage
Bluetooth FTMS connects to Zwift, Peloton & training apps
